description: Source file implementing tensor comparison operations for Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend in PyTorch, including functions for 'isin', 'where', 'nan_to_num', and related kernels.

classes.description: A cache structure for MPS graph objects used in tensor comparison operations.
